Okay, so here's a plan for today. First, I want Claude to look at the transcription path of Whisper below, because Apple's recognizer keeps mishearing names like Claude and Superbase. Then, I want to bench a few newer models, maybe Parakeet, maybe Whisper, and see which one is fastest on my Mac. If one of them wins on both speed and accuracy, we swap it in. If not, we keep Apple and fix the dictionary instead. Either way, I want the numbers before we change anything.

So the bug report from yesterday was that the pill jumps when the dictation ends, and I think it is the panel resizing itself, not the Swift UI frame. Could you open the pill demo file, run it with the left center anchor, and tell me how many points it moves? Then check the Git log for the commit that changed the sizing options, because I'm pretty sure that is where it started. Do not push anything yet. Just tell me when you what you find, and we will decide together on Slack with Christian.

I want to write a longer message to the team about the launch. We're going to ship the DMG on Friday, and the GitHub release will have the notes. Versel hosts the website, Cloudflare does the DNS, and the download link points at the release page. If anyone sees Gatekeeper complain, that is expected until we have a developer ID. So please don't tell people to strip the quarantine flag. Think in the near if something breaks, and I'll look at the Sentry dashboard first thing in the morning.
